name: od-astro-baseline-export
title: Export to Baseline Astro
description: Downstream export plugin for transmuting an accepted OpenDesign HTML/CSS artifact into Baseline zero-JS Astro primitives, global.css tokens, /_styleguide calibration, and EmDash CMS or static content bindings.

description_i18n.en: Downstream export plugin for transmuting an accepted OpenDesign HTML/CSS artifact into Baseline zero-JS Astro primitives, global.css tokens, /_styleguide calibration, and EmDash CMS or static content bindings.

query.en: Export the accepted OpenDesign artifact to a Baseline Astro route or reusable component. Preserve semantic global.css tokens, decompose into Section/Container/Grid/Card primitives on /_styleguide, and bind static Content Collections or EmDash live edit proxies.
